searchText: Hey, I wanted to ask about: https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-3554 How will this effectively impact mining? Will this be coming in Dec? <jhancock76> I’m December block times will start to slow down <jhancock76> Which means issuance also slows down <jhancock76> Unlikely to have an large affect as there is plenty of time to prepare for a simple fork to address it then.
